name: Garden and a Goat
storyline: In an alternate reality, an environmental artificial general intelligence was created to assist Earth’s ecosystems. As that mission was completed, the MOTHER intelligence turned to the multiverse to continue the work. The game brings you into that rewarding mission. Restore the ecosystems of the multiverse, garden by garden, as a robot tasked with restoring plants, attracting animals, and making them residents. Once complete more ecosystems and exotic looking, rare multiverse variants await!
summary: Garden and a Goat is a single-player animal collecting and ecosystem recovery game! You play as a friendly robot, eager to help a series of ecosystems in need. Clean up the environment, revive plants, and entice the local wildlife to return, unlocking ever more animals and decorations along the way!
